summary: Nebius Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiaries entered into a $775 million senior secured term loan facility to finance AI cloud buildout. The facility matures October 31, 2030, priced at SOFR + 2.50%, secured by borrower assets and GPU infrastructure. No merger, acquisition, tender, or restructuring is involved—the filing describes a routine debt financing arrangement. As a non-US issuer, this 6-K is equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K for a material definitive agreement. There is no special-situation event; the filing is a standard disclosure of a credit facility.
